title: 1871 Guatemalan Revolution
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1871 Guatemalan Revolution", at revision 1380768164, opens: "The Guatemalan Revolution of 1871 was a revolt led by Liberals under Justo Rufino Barrios and Miguel García Granados against the Conservative leadership of President Vicente Cerna y Cerna, the hand-picked successor of Rafael Carrera." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q6107157, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Military movement in Guatemala". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
